description: In the eighth year of Jinghan, the neighboring countries in the north of the Wu Dynasty were at war, and the south was temporarily at peace. When Ning Yi and Su Tan'er came to Lin'an City to do business, they suddenly encountered a dragon turning over. The bandit Thirteenth Army took advantage of the situation to capture Lin'an, causing the couple to be separated. The captured Ning Yi met the Thirteenth Army leaders Liu Xigua, Chen Fan and others one after another. They cherished each other and were both enemies and friends. In the midst of the disputes between the family and the country, the great Confucianists defended the way, heroes rose up, and the world changed...
